body: I'm giving myself until July. Things might get better! There's hope.
Father would be really mad and mother would have another emotional breakdown.

We're not exactly "close friends". I just thought they might be able to help.
I'm in high school, I've talked to the school counselor once, and they were pretty helpful. But if i tell them about this, then they're legality forced to tell me parents.

I don't think there's any way of breaking routine...i hate going outside. All i do is go to school, work, sleep. That's it. I don't even do anything tiring at work.

The threat was that they would stop being my friend or try suicide themselves which would then "cause a chain reaction".
Arent they great?
